ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Cookies Session Hijacking
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "curl.exe" with the "-c" flag in order to save cookie data.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "curl\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\s-c\s") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-cookie\\-jar.*")))
